verdict.rationale: The Titan Security Key is a FIDO/U2F hardware authenticator with no software interface where an AI assistant could live, so delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any such capability; the probe confirms it has no CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
